translations.en: could not help but feel terribly unfair.
Yet to cast that role aside now,
you were already too deeply involved and knew too much of the truth.
There could be no one better suited than you
to bear this burden and see the task through.
First, you would gather information.
Having settled the anxiety within you for now,
you pushed open the tavern door.
You're just in time.
Let me explain the current situation.
As a result of our search,
we've finally found a way past the entrance that had barred us
from exploring deeper into @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r.
What's more, some kind of key may have been left there,
so we need to search it immediately.
Incidentally...
We've heard nothing more about @7rLady Marbas@0r since then.
I'm afraid we still don't know whether she's alive.
And as for @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r's
last words about having allies...
We have no information about that either.
But the monsters have become even more active than before.
Perhaps they're taking some time
to choose a new leader.
That delay has worked in our favor,
but we discover a passage deeper into @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r,
and their activity increases at the very same time...
Doesn't it seem a little too convenient?
Either way, I'm counting on you.
We'll give you all the help we can, so do your best.
For the sake of protecting this town.
You look like you've cleared your head.
Personally, after several nights without sleep, I'd like to hurry to a hot spring
to fix what it's done to my skin.
Ideally, I'd head straight off on vacation.
I'm joking.
Um...
Word that @7rChu Lu Gah@0r's seals had been broken
spread through the town in no time.
We were heading straight toward a riot.
Somehow, we managed to avoid one.
But now the townspeople are constantly plagued by anxiety.
All they can do is hope this mist clears soon and the final seal is protected,
and wait.
That's how most of the people in this town feel.
Me? Well, I...
I'm doing something myself, so I'm not tormented by that helpless feeling.
I'll do everything I can
and devote myself to supporting you so you can win.
I feel like the monsters have gotten terribly strong lately.
Now it's dangerous everywhere around town too.
Even if the townspeople are counting on me because of that,
it doesn't make me happy.
I hope we can stop living like this soon.
Hey. You're looking pretty gloomy.
I suppose... I look gloomy too.
Everyone does. Everyone's tormented by anxiety.
Of course I'm scared...
But I've decided I won't run anymore.
I really mean it.
So I want you to watch me closely...
When I sit here drinking without a word,
people get some strange idea and nobody comes near me.
I prefer drinking quietly alone, so I don't mind.
The final seal...
So it has finally come to this.
How strange.
The very thing that bound me and kept me prisoner in this town
is now close at hand.
After all, my master's efforts have amounted to next to nothing.
The end was merely delayed by a few hundred years...
There is something terribly hollow about it...
Beyond the labyrinth lay an area inscribed with magic circles
so that a habitable base could be established there.
Apparently, the town was called @2rRukin@0r.
For now, you should go back and report to @7rBeatrix@0r.
When you enter the inn, you find a box waiting there.
